newsitem.title: USA: General Kinetics consents to delisting.
newsitem.headline: General Kinetics consents to delisting.

text.p: General Kinetics Inc on Wednesday said that it is consenting to the removal of its common stock from the American Stock Exchange, since the company does not fully satisfy all of the financial and market value guidelines of the AMEX for continued listing.
The AMEX has advised that the last day for trading the company's common stock will be Friday, May 23.
A market for the company's stock is expected to develop over-the-counter following termination of the AMEX listing, the company said.
